answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake before trading, with independent peers auditing its completed work. A newcomer starts on a low knoll of trust and earns higher limits only through verified, useful transactions over time. To forge many fake identities, an attacker must fund separate stake for each one and risks losing it when duplicates are detected. Honest verifiers in the same grove share fraud evidence, so one exposed fake poisons its whole cluster, making large-scale sybil creation expensive, slow, and unprofitable.
